name: casa-piazzola-lovere
description: Boutique holiday-rental site for a two-room apartment in the historic centre of Lovere, Lake Iseo.

scripts.setup: prisma generate && prisma db push && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:postgres: node -e "const f='prisma/schema.prisma',s=require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8');require('fs').writeFileSync(f,s.replace(/provider = \"sqlite\"/,'provider = \"postgresql\"'));console.log('schema.prisma now targets postgresql — set DATABASE_URL and run: npx prisma db push')"
